identity.title: Train A and B Source Range Neutron Flux Trip Functions Bypassed During Plant Startup

cause.proximate_text: The cause of the event was determined to be failure of the Operations crew to adequately track equipment status in accordance with operating procedures and processes. This was due to gaps in procedure use and adherence.
cause.theme: Equipment status tracking / procedure use and adherence gaps

nodes.display_name: Train A Source Range Neutron Flux Bypass Switch
Train B Source Range Neutron Flux Bypass Switch
Source range neutron flux trips placed in bypass for switchyard activities
nodes.description: On April 21, 2021 at 0738 hours with Unit 1 in Mode 5, both Train A and Train B source range neutron flux trips were placed in bypass per procedure in support of switchyard activities.

nodes.display_name: Restoration of source range trips not performed after switching activities completed
nodes.description: At the completion of the switching activities, the restoration of the source range neutron flux trips was not performed, and the trip functions remained in bypass until discovery on April 23, 2021.

nodes.display_name: Mode change to Mode 4 with source range trips inoperable, TS LCO 3.0.4 not met
nodes.description: April 21, 2021 at 2221 hours, Unit 1 entered Mode 4 with both source range neutron flux trip functions inoperable; TS 3.3.1 was not met prior to mode change.

nodes.display_name: Mode change to Mode 2 with source range trips inoperable, TS LCO 3.0.4 not met
nodes.description: April 23, 2021 at 1154 hours, Unit 1 entered Mode 2 with both source range neutron flux trip functions inoperable; TS 3.3.1 not met prior to mode change; Required Action H.1 not met.

nodes.display_name: Safety System Functional Failure / loss of source range trip safety function; TS Required Actions and LCO 3.0.4 not met
Implement observation plan to improve quality of control board walkdowns

chain: gaps in procedure use/adherence [cause TBD] -> source range trips placed in bypass for switchyard work -> restoration not performed after work completed -> Mode 4 entry with trips inoperable, LCO 3.0.4 not met -> Mode 2 entry with trips inoperable, LCO 3.0.4 not met -> Safety System Functional Failure / loss of source range trip safety function (no actual safety consequence, boron concentration confirmed adequate)
notes: Cause code and category reported as TBD/provisional on FORM-366; narrative provides a proximate cause statement (Operations crew failure to track equipment status, procedure gaps) but no formal cause code was assigned, so cause node is marked provisional per rule 4. No Block 13 rows and no component failure data (N/A) were provided, consistent with a purely procedural/human-performance event with no equipment failure. Reactor trip breaker cycling events are recorded as part of the TS 3.0.4/Required Action non-compliance narrative but are procedural instances rather than distinct physical failure modes, so they were not separately modeled beyond the two mode-change failure modes that directly produced the SSFF consequence. No backup systems were cited as operable substitutes for the source range function during the bypass window (RCS boron concentration was verified adequate instead), so no BACKED_UP_BY edges were created.
